name: JSON language server
description: JSON language server using pinned complete upstream npm distributions.

runtime_requirements.declared_dependency_engine_note: Full upstream distribution includes vscode-markdown-languageservice>=22 even when the selected entry does not use Markdown.

setup_requirements: Remote schema downloads are not part of offline qualification.
optional_dependency_policy: All nonoptional packages plus the three supported Astro native compiler bindings; optional fsevents omitted in Pyright (portable polling remains).
canonical_packing: Requires released Linux x86_64 CLI 0.15.6 with LSP entry limit 16384; never pack with a macOS source build for byte reproduction.
